name: Feast
description: Enters a feeding frenzy for %duration% turns, making %attacks% free attack on an adjacent enemy each turn.
details: Each free attack heals this unit for %lifesteal:pct%% of the damage dealt and roots the victim for %root_duration% turn.
This unit is free to move and act as normal throughout.

upgrade.summary: Casting this on an enemy latches this unit onto them instead of just biting whoever's adjacent.
upgrade.description: Becomes unit-targetable at %cast_range% range. Cast on an enemy, this unit latches onto them for %duration% turns: it occupies their tile, becomes untargetable and invulnerable, and automatically follows wherever they go.
details: While latched, the free attacks always target the latched unit, %latch_attacks% per turn instead of %attacks% - proccing immediately on cast and again each of Grivath's turns - each still healing this unit for %lifesteal:pct%% of the damage dealt and rooting the target for %root_duration% turn.
While latched, this unit is disarmed and silenced - it can only move. Moving away from the latched unit ends the latch early, and whatever duration remains just acts like the base ability.

If the latched unit dies, or is no longer a valid target, this unit pops off - untargetable, invulnerable, disarmed and silenced all end, and whatever duration remains just acts like the base ability (a free attack on a random adjacent enemy each turn).
Cast on itself instead, this acts exactly like the base ability - no latch, no untargetability.
